description.value: We investigated which neural mechanisms underlie acute tramadol action in healthy adults by using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI). Especially, we focused on reward anticipation while performing the MID task to scrutinize the possible involvement of tramadol in substance abuse disorders.
